configuration_actually_measured.degraded_because: this is the Phase A run: legal modules had not been built, so it measures the stage-1 fallback path, not the full cascade

stage1_latency.definition: gen_latency_s + scoring_s per item, legal modules excluded

full_cascade_latency.reason: the frozen runs time only generation and record construction; relation, detection, estimation and decision stages are not instrumented, so no cascade latency is derivable from them
full_cascade_latency.how_to_measure: scripts/43_measure_deployment.py --timings <file> on the target laptop, or --instrument during a live run

peak_resident_memory.reason: no memory sampling exists in any Phase A-F run
peak_resident_memory.how_to_measure: psutil.Process().memory_info().rss sampled during a live query, or resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss on POSIX; record which one was used

rule: a degraded configuration must be described, not hidden; the report states what ran (guide §21.3)
